title: An algebra generated by finitely many integral elements is finite
statement: Let $R\to B$ be a ring map and $b_1,\dots,b_m\in B$ elements generating $B$ as an $R$-algebra, each integral over $R$ (a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of $R$). Then $B$ is a finitely generated $R$-module, i.e. $R\to B$ is finite.
